verdicts.reason: binfmt_misc_entry holds magic, mask, interpreter, interps, users; bh_lru holds buffer_head pointer array (instantiated per-CPU); eventpoll holds wq/poll_wait/rdllist and rbr tree.
Fragments show io_setup, io_submit (bounded to nr_events), and io_getevents, but omit cancel (sys_io_cancel), destroy/drain (sys_io_destroy), and compat syscalls.
bprm_execve forces SIGSEGV if point_of_no_return is set; alloc_fd returns -EMFILE on exhaustion; pipe_resize_ring returns -EBUSY if nr_slots < pipe_occupancy.
wait_for_space/splice_to_pipe send SIGPIPE/-EPIPE if !readers; fillonedir handles -EFAULT/-EOVERFLOW; cp_old_stat/do_statfs_native return -EOVERFLOW; destroy_super_rcu defers via workqueue.

overall: 3 findings (5, 7, 8) are fully supported by the cited fragments; finding 6 is partial because cancel, destroy/drain, and compat narrow handlers are claimed but omitted from the cited fragments.
